//requireLogin: Named accounts, on by default, so every ticket, case and evidence upload is attributable to a person. The first account is created from the login screen on first run - there is nothing to set up here and no way to lock yourself out. The analyst token above keeps working as the break-glass and automation credential either way. Set false for a single-analyst lab where a shared token is enough.
//ai: The AI Analyst tab. The browser never sees this key - it posts to AEGIS and AEGIS calls Anthropic. Prefer setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment over writing the key to this file; the env var wins if both are set. Leave apiKey empty and the AI tab reports itself unconfigured instead of failing.
